# LinkAGI

> LinkAGI is an operator-maintained, Chinese-language AI API relay with CNY usage-based billing. This site provides its API starter resources and setup guide.

Users can create separate API keys for projects, select a model and group, and inspect per-request token usage and charges. Current model availability and pricing are published in the model marketplace. Join QQ group 342205412 to claim CNY 3 in trial credit.

## Product and account

- [Website](https://api.linktoagi.com/): LinkAGI product homepage.
- [Sign up](https://api.linktoagi.com/sign-up): Create an account.
- [Models and pricing](https://api.linktoagi.com/pricing): Current models, groups and prices.
- [Support](https://docs.linktoagi.com/about.html#support): Customer support and trial requests.
- [Trial contact guide](https://16871233.github.io/linkagi-api-starter/#trial): Customer support QR code, business email and QQ group 342205412.

Codex Plus has a group multiplier of 0.18 and Pro 0.25. GPT prices in the starter table are for the standard short-context tier (≤272k); long-context and other service-tier prices are listed in the live model marketplace.

## Integration resources

- [Setup and token-cost calculator](https://16871233.github.io/linkagi-api-starter/): Client-specific base URLs, a price table and a local calculator.
- [GPT group selection](https://16871233.github.io/linkagi-api-starter/gpt-groups.html): Sale 0.15 is Codex-only; Plus 0.18 and Pro 0.25 allow external clients. Includes GPT-6.1 Sol unit prices and trial entry.
- [Chinese documentation](https://docs.linktoagi.com/): Client configuration instructions.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/16871233/linkagi-api-starter/main/openapi/linkagi.openapi.json): Starter request schema.
- [Integration status](https://github.com/16871233/linkagi-api-starter/blob/main/INTEGRATION_STATUS.md): Scope and evidence of completed interface tests.

The OpenAI-compatible base URL is `https://api.linktoagi.com/v1`. The public model marketplace restricts the Codex Sale group to Codex; custom scripts and other OpenAI-compatible clients should select a Plus or Pro group labeled for external clients and check the model's endpoint type. An account API key and calling balance are required. Never send API keys to this static documentation site. LinkAGI is an independent third-party service.
